subject: Aligning demo window with traffic fingerprint — next steps
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@shopnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Aligning demo window with traffic fingerprint — next steps

Hi Samira,

Thanks for signing up and trying Redwood — glad to see ShopNova kicking the tires. I reviewed the short intake you filled out and had a couple quick questions that help us tailor the demo (and pick the right slices to show live):

- Primary production use case: is this primarily product recommendations, search relevance, or a hybrid (mix of rerank + generation)?
- Expected peak RPS / TPS during launches or promotions (ballpark is fine).
- Typical input size / sequence length (tokens or words) and whether you pad requests for a fixed length.
- Timeline: when would you like a pilot environment up (weeks/months)?
- Any security/compliance must-haves (SSO, SOC2, data retention windows) we should know about before demoing Dedicated/Private options.

If you can share short answers I can scope the demo to show latency at your traffic profile and a quick cost-oriented config (batching + quantization tradeoffs). I attached a 2-page demo deck and a tiny traffic-template.csv you can drop numbers into.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Aug 1 — 11:00–11:30
- Wed Aug 2 — 11:00–11:30
- Thu Aug 3 — 15:00–15:30

If none of those work, tell me a window you prefer and I’ll loop in Ben (solutions) to go deeper into throughput/latency tuning during the call.

Quick note: if you have a short traffic sample (1–2k requests across peak and off-peak) we can run a targeted profile beforehand which makes the live demo much more realistic.

Thanks — Kim

Kimberly Park
SDR | Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
(Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf; traffic-template.csv)

From: Samira Khan <samira@shopnova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T10:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo window with traffic fingerprint — next steps

Hi Kim,

Thanks — happy to answer. Short answers below:
- Use case: primarily product recommendations (real-time scoring) with occasional search rerank for promotional pushes.
- Peak: baseline ~120 RPS, peaks up to ~430 RPS during flash sales (peaks last 10–20 mins).
- Average sequence length: ~75–90 tokens (most inputs are compact user/profile + product context).
- Timeline: target pilot kickoff mid-September, production in Q4 if pilot looks good.
- Security: SOC2 is required for vendor selection; SSO would be great but not mandatory for pilot.

I won’t have a traffic dump today but I can share aggregated hourly rates and a small sample the infra team keeps. Also — can we aim for a demo later in the day PST? I’m tied up in customer calls in the morning.

Best,
Samira
Samira Khan
Head of ML Engineering | ShopNova
samira@shopnova.com

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Samira Khan <samira@shopnova.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-07-30T12:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo window with traffic fingerprint — next steps

Great — really helpful context, thanks. A couple quick clarifications so Ben can size the demo infra correctly:

- For the peaks you mentioned (up to 430 RPS), is that sustained for multiple hours during promotions or short bursts (minutes)?
- Do you expect traffic to be very bursty (e.g., 10x baseline for 5–15 minutes) or more like steady growth?
- For the sample: aggregated hourly rates are perfect. If you can drop the CSV into the template I sent we’ll run a quick profile.

Ben will cover: live throughput/latency at your token lengths, batching strategies (how we trade cost vs latency), and a short walkthrough of Dedicated vs Hosted routing for predictable throughput. We’ll also cover our SOC2 posture and the options for a pilot VPC if you prefer.

Since you prefer later PT, here are 3 late-afternoon slots (PT):
- Wed Aug 2 — 11:00–11:30 PT (still morning for you, but we can do later if needed)
- Wed Aug 2 — 15:00–15:30 PT
- Thu Aug 3 — 16:00–16:30 PT

If Wed 8/2 15:00 PT works, I’ll have Ben and Monica (CS lead) join. I’ve attached the same deck again and the traffic template — please fill the hourly aggregates if possible and send back.

(Attachment: redwood-demo-deck.pdf; traffic-template.csv)

— Kim

From: Samira Khan <samira@shopnova.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: Darren Cole <darren@shopnova.com>
Date: 2028-07-30T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Aligning demo window with traffic fingerprint — next steps

Kim, Ben — thanks. Quick answers:
- Peaks are short bursts: usually 8–20 minutes during home-page promos; we see a 3x–4x uplift from baseline during those windows.
- Traffic is bursty (not steady), our throttling today smooths some of that but we want to see what tight latency SLOs look like under bursts.
- I attached an aggregated hourly CSV and a tiny sample set (we put the export on an internal share). Link: https://files.shopnova.com/export/sample-traffic-2307.json (private link)

Wed Aug 2 at 15:00 PT works best for us. Can the demo cover:
- Live tail latency under burst (p95/p99) and batching behavior
- Quantized model performance vs FP16 tradeoffs
- What a minimal pilot config looks like (rough cost estimate + timelines)

Looping in Darren (infra) — he’ll help with the sample export and any firewall/ingress notes.

Thanks,
Samira
